title: Photronics to Participate in 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Photronics, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.

## Photronics to Participate in 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit


September 30, 2026 at 4:00 PM EDT


[PDF Version](https://photronicsinc.gcs-web.com/node/19741/pdf)


BROOKFIELD, Conn., Sept. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Photronics, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=z2Ij44SzeXGnRlaAM3mjpVQEUhiMTASv7_5MQALkquxEx16ww3M1z4z5X6bPn5XcIwk5aksUdIdIIzX_yRK1nuhXP8jfVAxqa5UAP1DL5XwWlyR3WT2mpTXqgdRA5u4z) (Nasdaq:PLAB), a worldwide leader in photomask technologies and solutions, today announced it will participate in the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit being held Tuesday, October 13th at the St. Regis Hotel in San Francisco, California.


**About the 18** **th** **Annual CEO Summit**


The CEO Summit is hosted by participating companies and features a “round-robin” format consisting of small group meetings with company management teams. Attendance at the CEO Investor Summit is by invitation only and is available solely to accredited investors and publishing research analysts. As space is limited, please RSVP early. Hosts reserve the right to limit attendance as necessary.


To RSVP for the CEO Investor Summit, please contact either of the event co-chairs:

**About Photronics**


[Photronics](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=z2Ij44SzeXGnRlaAM3mjpfvFDV_VMxAIERyNmKmBgJGSA_r8ckNZMZN6MXkzw7_GciTUCW4BVjPSKtpwthQmxRnSfj5y1FInFpFac7t6Qm0=) is a leading worldwide manufacturer of integrated circuit (IC) and flat panel display (FPD)[photomasks.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3bK9EPjeOmjO2Jwt-C90sd41tQtK0iKhi8W80z9o6K2ilO9reVfAeIxHBUABHAD0NofWiXfGT3YMFb13s5j-CDZcgftz3jESAENycPoEe1x8ZPLcz9elGa5JNjfocfAh2Ra7f2u6GA_s6r9bNZ-4g2y8N-jXYWAdZalHGmBjEXk=) High precision quartz plates that contain microscopic images of electronic circuits, photomasks are a key element in the IC and FPD manufacturing process. Founded in 1969, Photronics has been a trusted photomask supplier for over 56 years. The company operates 11 strategically located[manufacturing facilities](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cfexSBvsHJKb9oNvPAeJ3-jtuaV1UNsD7BynFerxo8GcFCSI0CT1Lj2ZRoOm05N_UWHddSP1Xni0EkkSQSL1BKJTOAPrX-zEDNlvfd93872nyTcwj9HY2Tt6KapQUGRxlYu6oCyiYOm0w9pQwcDq9A==) in Asia, Europe, and North America. Additional information on the company can be accessed at[www.photronics.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=YRt7I-bPS_BSAn-PdeFomor_o9muLFjnH6r90KoQIyT90E_GJmkfTQTOq7tB9WUIFvoE_Sqytb-HNyrxocw7db8VPX-5qwUhUDXHV0449Kw=) .
